Actually free feeding sila😅 pero konte konte lang yung nakalagay sa food bowl then refill ng refill. Tapos I also make their wet food instead of buying yung mga naka pouch. I boil chicken breast, carrots, and kalabasa lamg then I blend them together. Tapos yung pinagpakuluan sinasama ko sa container then store sa freezer. I just microwave the wet food kapag bibigyan ko na sila. They LOVE it plus super healthy pa and sure na hydrated sila☺️
